canada.title: Quebec Superior Court hears arguments to suspend Montreal bylaw banning insults
canada.summary: Lawyers are asking Quebec Superior Court to suspend a recently-adopted bylaw banning insults against employees of the city of Montreal, including police officers.

canada.title: World juniors pre-tournament schedule set with six Alberta cities to host 12 games
canada.summary: The pre-tournament schedule for the upcoming world junior hockey championship has been set, with six Alberta towns hosting 12 games from Dec. 17-23.

canada.title: Taking the road less travelled by: Montreal rideshare driver releases poetry collection
canada.summary: After eight years of balancing 10-hour workdays and writing, Jibril Adamu is releasing his first poetry collection, Ode to a Red Country Rooster, at the end of the month.

canada.title: Hiring more police officers makes sense, but a bigger force won’t guarantee less crime
canada.summary: Public safety was front and centre at two Winnipeg mayoral debates Wednesday, with candidates promising more police officers, tougher responses to crime and a safer city.

canada.title: N.L. spent $32.1 million in 2.5 years on private virtual health-care services
canada.summary: A mayor in rural Newfoundland says most people in his community who needed urgent care in the past few years arrived at the local health centre and "talked to a TV."

canada.title: May preliminary inquiry for man accused of Moncton murder
canada.summary: A preliminary inquiry has been scheduled for next spring for a man accused of a murder in Moncton.

canada.title: Man charged with murder in death of 20-year-old in Regina
canada.summary: A 25-year-old man was charged with first-degree murder in relation to the killing of Deandre Lagimodiere, 20, the Regina Police Service said.

canada.title: Ottawa ‘not responsible’ for regulating AI data centre power use: minister
canada.summary: AI Minister Evan Solomon spoke to the Senate Committee on Social Affairs, Science and Technology on Thursday, where he was asked about power usage by data centres Canada.

canada.title: Unhappy N.B. Tory says he’s launching new right-wing party
canada.summary: A Progressive Conservative unhappy that Daniel Allain won the party leadership says he is going to start a centre-right party called the New Brunswick Party.

canada.title: Korchinski-Paquet's mother makes new allegation against police during coroner's inquest
canada.summary: A coroner's inquest into the death of Regis Korchinski-Paquet, who fell from her balcony in 2020, was scrambling to find a way forward Thursday after the Toronto woman's mother unexpectedly made a new allegation against police officers during her testimony.

canada.title: YWCA N.W.T. announces independent review, delays annual general meeting for second time
canada.summary: The YWCA NWT has postponed its annual general meeting a second time, saying it needs time for an independent review of the organization.

canada.title: Mississauga man convicted in U.S. terror probe gets additional 50-year prison sentence
canada.summary: A Mississauga man serving a 40-year sentence for terror-related charges in the U.S. was sentenced to an additional 50 years in federal prison in relation to an assault against two corrections officers, the U.S. Attorney's Office announced Monday.

canada.title: 'Let's do it right': N.W.T. downstream leaders and advocates on Alta. oilsands tailings release
canada.summary: Advocates and Indigenous communities call for federal and N.W.T. leaders to review Suncor’s proposed oilsands tailings release into the Athabasca River system, citing major scientific data gaps and a moral duty to protect downstream waters.

canada.title: ‘Gratifying and humbling’: First Nation leads ghost net cleanup from Interior B.C. rivers
canada.summary: Discarded fishing gear can trap and kill fish. Lytton First Nation has been removing it from Fraser and Thompson rivers since 2006

canada.title: Fact-checking the B.C. NDP's record — and major parties' promises — on seniors care
canada.summary: The B.C. NDP promised to add 5,400 new long-term care beds to the system in 2024. They also pledged to expand access to home care, to enable seniors who want to live at home to continue to do so. Here’s a look at what they delivered and what the major parties are promising to do if elected.

canada.title: Fall storm could bring 15-25 cm of snow to northern Manitoba
canada.summary: A "significant fall storm" is headed to northern Manitoba, bringing rain that will transition into heavy, wet snow with as much as 15 to 25 centimetres expected, says Environment Canada.

canada.title: Firm behind planned Anthropic data centre in Nova Scotia denies owing fees to N.L.
canada.summary: EverWind, a company planning a massive data centre in Nova Scotia for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, is in the midst of a dispute about land fees for a failed wind-powered hydrogen project in southern Newfoundland.

canada.title: Tumbler Ridge conspiracy suspect James Bryant pleads not guilty in U.S. court
canada.summary: The alleged co-conspirator in the deadly mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., has pleaded not guilty in a U.S. court and is set to go on trial in December.
